name: Odameido(15)
source:
Before you knew it, you found yourself in a colorless room.
According to the suspicious-looking waiter, it is a "restaurant just for you" inside a dream.
While engaging in laid-back and silly conversations with him, you have to answer 15 questions.
It would be nice if you could enjoy a delicious meal even after waking up from the dream.
